review.tagline: Mojo language and MAX inference framework with an OpenAI-compatible server
review.summary: Monorepo for the open-source parts of the Modular Platform: the Mojo compiler and standard library, the MAX accelerator kernel library, and MAX Python model pipelines. MAX includes an inference server that exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The repo code is Apache 2.0 with LLVM Exceptions, while MAX usage and distribution fall under the Modular Community License.
review.audience: Engineers serving models with MAX or writing GPU kernels in Mojo
strengths: Serving layer exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, per the README
Open kernels, Mojo stdlib and model architectures accept outside contributions
Includes Python-based model pipelines and code examples for MAX and Mojo
weaknesses: Two licenses: repo is Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions, MAX uses Modular Community License
Mojo compiler is not open to contributions yet
README gives no hardware requirements or supported model list
Broad platform repo; serving is one part, so setup is spread across separate docs
needs: Models: Hugging Face models via MAX pipelines
